description: Mystic Snow Spirit default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/mystic_snow_spirit-character-sheet.png: the palette chips (intake.json swatches snow 237,238,242 / blue-shadow 193,215,237 / icy blue 92,173,214 / navy 46,67,108 / violet 139,93,253 / dark 51,53,58 inferred) cross-checked against the drawn surfaces (service venv PIL, median of a box per surface; boxes in each note).
